summary: Lightning AI's free tier: 5 free Lightning credits (~$5) on registration, plus 25 more when you add a card; marketing cites up to ~80 free GPU hours after phone verification; every account gets 1 free 4-CPU Studio and the first 10 GB of Drive storage free. Free credits are promotional, non-transferable, and expire 12 months after purchase/grant. (Pricing page is JS-rendered; terms corroborated via official lightning.ai pricing/docs pages in the search index.)
claim_steps: Create a free account at lightning.ai — no credit card required.
Verify your phone number to receive up to ~80 free GPU hours.
Get 5 free Lightning credits on registration; add a card for 25 more.
Start on the free 4-CPU Studio; switch to GPU when ready to run.
